approved_amendments.scope: Approve the monthly repository hygiene process direction and proceed to stage a separate implementation WCS.
limits: The monthly process must review candidates before cleanup.

execution.objective: Define and materialize a repeatable repository hygiene cycle that reviews cleanup candidates periodically and permits removals only through separate itemized approval.

proposed_cadence.activation_requires: Approval of the periodic process WCS before operation.
proposed_cadence.approval: Founder approved the monthly cadence on 2026-10-15.

success_criteria: Define a monthly repository inventory and candidate-review cycle with dated reports and machine-readable registers.
Inventory tracked, untracked, and ignored paths separately; inspect secret-related paths by metadata only and never read secret values.
Classify each candidate using the lifecycle standard and record existence, Git state, references, ownership evidence, recovery value, confidence, and disposition.
Keep uncertain, protected, active, or recovery-relevant items out of cleanup eligibility.
Require a separate itemized WCS and authority for each cleanup run, listing exact paths, evidence, hashes where applicable, and rollback or recovery considerations.
Require founder review and approval of the itemized cleanup scope before any deletion, move, rename, or archive.
Do not execute existing broad cleanup scripts or perform automatic deletion.
Do not modify runtime, Builder scripts, packages, database, Supabase, or deployment files as part of the recurring inventory process.
Document how a cycle is started, reviewed, approved, recorded, and closed.

unlocks: A recurring read-only repository hygiene procedure after separate approval.
Separate itemized cleanup WCS cycles only for candidates that pass review.

forbidden_surface: Package creation, regeneration, overwrite, or mutation
Deployment, database, Supabase, and secret values

founder_runtime_test.expected_outcome: A periodic hygiene process WCS draft is staged for founder review.
